tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background (Tailwind bg-bg). Same value as paper.

tokens.name: background-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate section bands and spotlight cards (bg-bg-alt).

tokens.name: background-elevated
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces (bg-bg-elevated).

tokens.name: background-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on paper rows and controls (bg-bg-hover).

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text (text-text-primary) on background, background-alt, card.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text and body copy (text-text-secondary) on background, background-alt, card.

tokens.name: tertiary-foreground
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: captions, metric labels (text-text-tertiary) on background, card and background-alt (4.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards, inputs, dividers (border-border).

tokens.name: border-emphasis
tokens.usage: Stronger divider where a hairline would disappear (border-border-emphasis).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, active nav, focused input border, checked switch (text-accent, bg-accent). Same hue as pine.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent links and controls.

tokens.name: accent-light
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind pine text, e.g. the secondary Button (bg-accent-light).

tokens.name: accent-muted
tokens.usage: Faintest pine wash for selected rows.

tokens.name: optimal
tokens.usage: Positive values and the recommended result (text-optimal, badge-positive). Text on card and background.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Costs, losses and errors as text (text-negative, badge-negative, destructive Button). Text on card and background.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Neutral deltas and inactive markers (text-neutral).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card and input background (bg-card); also the edge colour of chart scroll fades.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour (ring-ring).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, the darkest neutral (text-ink).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text and long-form body copy (text-ink-soft).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Muted text and captions (text-ink-muted). Passes 4.5:1 on card and paper; misses on paper-warm and background-alt (about 4:1), so use tertiary-foreground for small text there.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background (bg-paper).

tokens.name: paper-warm
tokens.usage: Alternate bands, spotlight cards, neutral badge fill, scrollbar track (bg-paper-warm).

tokens.name: paper-deep
tokens.usage: Hover fills, empty tracks, unchecked switch (bg-paper-deep).

tokens.name: paper-stone
tokens.usage: Other income segments, axis lines, hovered glass border (bg-paper-stone).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: All hairline borders in charts and SVG (PALETTE.line).

tokens.name: pine
tokens.usage: Brand green: links, active nav, italic headline phrases, hovered primary button (text-pine).

tokens.name: pine-deep
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, dark bands, tooltips (bg-pine-deep). Cream #f5f2ea text on it.

tokens.name: pine-mid
tokens.usage: Conversion segments, positive values, recommended card border, pine eyebrow (text-pine-mid).

tokens.name: pine-line
tokens.usage: Borders on pine-deep surfaces, e.g. the tooltip edge.

tokens.name: pine-mist
tokens.usage: Muted text and dotted step connectors on pine-deep; dotted line in Steps.

tokens.name: pine-haze
tokens.usage: Body text on pine-deep (tooltips, dark bands).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Secondary green: current-selection card border, gradient end, step numbers, taxable series.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: The only warm accent: RMDs, cliffs, danger markers, 32%+ brackets. Fills and marks only, never text on light grounds (3:1). Never decorative.

tokens.name: ember-text
tokens.usage: Ember as text on card and paper (5:1). Misses 4.5:1 on paper-warm (4.4:1): use destructive there.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Caution markers; also the 22% bracket (text-caution, bg-caution). Not for text.

tokens.name: bracket-10
tokens.usage: 10% bracket fill. Low brackets read green, high brackets ember (BRACKET_COLORS).

tokens.name: bracket-12
tokens.usage: 12% bracket fill. Low brackets read green, high brackets ember (BRACKET_COLORS).

tokens.name: bracket-22
tokens.usage: 22% bracket fill. Low brackets read green, high brackets ember (BRACKET_COLORS).

tokens.name: bracket-24
tokens.usage: 24% bracket fill. Low brackets read green, high brackets ember (BRACKET_COLORS).

tokens.name: bracket-32
tokens.usage: 32% bracket fill. Low brackets read green, high brackets ember (BRACKET_COLORS).

tokens.name: bracket-35
tokens.usage: 35% bracket fill. Low brackets read green, high brackets ember (BRACKET_COLORS).

tokens.name: bracket-37
tokens.usage: 37% bracket fill. Low brackets read green, high brackets ember (BRACKET_COLORS).

tokens.name: chart-income
tokens.usage: Other income and pre-tax series (CHART_COLORS.income).

tokens.name: chart-rmd
tokens.usage: Required minimum distribution series (CHART_COLORS.rmd).

tokens.name: chart-withdrawal
tokens.usage: Withdrawals from the traditional account that fund spending (CHART_COLORS.withdrawal).

tokens.name: chart-social-security
tokens.usage: Taxable part of Social Security, drawn right under the conversion (CHART_COLORS.socialSecurity).

tokens.name: chart-conversion
tokens.usage: Roth conversion series; fades to sage in bars (CHART_COLORS.conversion).

tokens.name: chart-taxable
tokens.usage: Taxable conversion series (CHART_COLORS.taxable).

tokens.name: chart-remaining
tokens.usage: Remaining bracket space fill (CHART_COLORS.remaining).

tokens.name: chart-remaining-stroke
tokens.usage: Outline of remaining bracket space (CHART_COLORS.remainingStroke).

tokens.name: chart-slider-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled slider track (CHART_COLORS.sliderTrack).

tokens.name: glass-bg
tokens.usage: Subtle surface tint; Skeleton fill (bg-glass-bg; legacy name).

tokens.name: glass-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered tint; highlighted Select item (bg-glass-bg-hover).

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: Hairline border of tinted surfaces (border-glass-border).

tokens.name: glass-border-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered tinted-surface border.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero h1. Fluid in code: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5.4rem); 5.4rem is the desktop size.
styles.sample: Fill your brackets, not the IRS's.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section h2 with .display-heading. Fluid in code: clamp(2.1rem, 4.4vw, 3.4rem).
styles.sample: A yes/no answer isn't a plan.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary copy, card descriptions, small buttons.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Labels above numbers (.metric-label), notes under stats.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small uppercase mono caption (.eyebrow), e.g. LIFETIME INCOME MAP; section numbers, years.

tokens.name: space-micro
tokens.usage: Icon gaps, label-to-value (micro).

tokens.name: space-tight
tokens.usage: Stacked lines inside a component (tight).

tokens.name: space-default
tokens.usage: Default gap, phone card padding (default).

tokens.name: space-comfortable
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a card (comfortable).

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gaps between cards (section).

tokens.name: space-section-lg
tokens.usage: Gaps between page groups (section-lg).

tokens.name: space-page
tokens.usage: Page-level vertical rhythm (page).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips, Select items (rounded-sm).

tokens.name: radius-default
tokens.usage: Tooltips, small panels (rounded).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards on phones (rounded-md).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards on desktop (rounded-lg).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large panels (rounded-xl); dark bands use 26px in code.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: The --radius variable: card corner radius.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Tailwind shadow-card. Green-tinted, very soft.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: Interactive card on hover, with a 5px lift.

tokens.name: shadow-elevated
tokens.usage: Popovers, Select menu, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-card-rest
tokens.usage: The .card class's own shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-card-recommended
tokens.usage: .card-recommended.

tokens.name: shadow-card-current
tokens.usage: .card-current.

tokens.name: shadow-card-elevated
tokens.usage: .card-elevated.

tokens.name: shadow-conversation
tokens.usage: Result, what-if and scenario cards in a conversation and in MCP App iframes, which clip wider shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-button-hover
tokens.usage: Primary pill button on hover.

tokens.name: max-w-content
tokens.usage: App views (max-w-content).

tokens.name: max-w-wide
tokens.usage: Marketing sections (max-w-wide).
